label: Coats
finding: Only 8 stores have real coats or jackets at 40% off or more, 48 pieces in total, and once you take out the denim and cropped jackets only 18 are actual coats, in 5 stores.

picks.name: Dillon Trench Coat
picks.chip: Final sale. S and XL gone
picks.say: This trench was 389 dollars and it is 99. Seventy five percent off. It is final sale and two sizes are already gone, so know your size.
picks.why: Biggest markdown on a real coat in everything I read. Belted, double-breasted, chocolate brown.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants a long trench under $100 and is sure of her size.
picks.skip_if: You need returns, or you want a cotton trench. This one is 96% polyester.

picks.name: Convertible Puffer, Oat
picks.say: The cheapest coat on my list. 68 dollars, and every size from 2XS to 4XL is still there. The photos show it worn as a vest too.
picks.why: Cheapest real outerwear at 40% off or more, and the only pick with a full size run from 2XS to 4XL.
picks.for_who: Gym-to-errands dressing, and sizes most of these stores do not carry.
picks.skip_if: You want a long warm coat. It is cropped, and the store says little about the fill.

picks.name: Hayes Denim Trench
picks.say: A denim trench at half off. 114 dollars. I think this is the one coat here you can wear in spring too.
picks.why: Half off, all five sizes in stock, and a shape you do not see in every store.
picks.for_who: Mild winters. Works over a dress or with white jeans.
picks.skip_if: You need actual warmth. It is denim.

picks.name: Betty Shearling Jacket
picks.say: Corduroy with shearling lining and little wooden toggles. 250, down from 416. Not cheap, but look at the back of it.
picks.why: The body is fully shearling-lined and the sleeves are quilted, per the store. The back seaming is the best detail.
picks.for_who: Jeans and a white tee, every day until March.
picks.skip_if: You want room for a thick sweater. The store calls the fit shrunken, with slim sleeves.

picks.name: Martina Leopard Jacket
picks.say: Hot take. One leopard jacket does more for your closet than a third black coat. This one is half wool and it is 149.
picks.why: 50% wool, fully lined, half off, every size left.
picks.for_who: Anyone bored of her black coat.
picks.skip_if: You are petite and hate volume. The collar is big and the shoulders drop.

picks.name: Bronte Puffer Coat
picks.say: A puffer that does not look like a sleeping bag. That collar. Half off, 198. The store says to size down.
picks.why: The collar makes it. Half off, and the store says it is made in Europe.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants a puffer she can wear to dinner.
picks.skip_if: You need XL or XXL, those are gone. Or you want a hood.

picks.name: Drew Maxi Coat, Hibiscus
picks.say: My splurge. A red maxi coat in a merino wool blend. It was 1,195 and it is 717. Still a lot. But this is the coat people will ask you about.
picks.why: The only long red wool-blend coat in the whole list. 40% off saves $478.
picks.for_who: A holiday party coat you wear over everything.
picks.skip_if: $717 hurts, or you want a coat that blends in.

picks.name: Maren Wool Coat, Burgundy
picks.say: My favorite. 100 percent Italian virgin wool, fully lined, 239 dollars. Read the fabric tags on coats at this price. Most of them are polyester.
picks.why: 100% Italian virgin wool with a viscose lining at $239. Diagonal zip and a high wrap collar.
picks.for_who: Cold cities. Someone who checks fabric labels.
picks.skip_if: You want a classic straight hem. This one is asymmetric and dry clean only.

script.open: I read almost 400 Black Friday sales. Only 8 stores have coats or jackets at 40 percent off, and only 5 of them have an actual coat. Here are my eight favorites.
script.close: That is every coat worth buying out of almost 400 sales. Which one would you actually wear?
script.tease: Blazers. I kept them out of this one on purpose, and there are a lot of them.

hooks_alt: Everyone says coats are on sale this week. I checked almost 400 sales and found 18 real coats at 40 percent off.
This trench was 389 dollars. It is 99 right now, and almost nobody is talking about it.
caption: I read almost 400 Black Friday sales and only 8 stores had coats or jackets at 40% off or more. These are the eight I would buy, from $68 to $717. Which one is yours? Commissionable links in bio.
pinned_comment: How I counted: women's coats, trenches, puffers and real jackets, at 40% off or more of their own original price, with at least half the sizes in stock. 48 pieces in 8 stores. Blazers and gym zip-ups not included. Prices read Nov 26-27.
recheck: None of the 8 was rechecked live today (the price check was blocked in this session, and Marcella refuses it anyway). Open all 8 pages and confirm price and sizes before posting.
bübish Dillon Trench: final sale, only XS, M, L were in stock. It can sell out fast; have Charlee Long Coat ($99, was $399, final sale, XS to L) ready as the swap.
bübish is an Australian brand. Prices on bubishluxe.us are in USD per the catalog, but check where it ships from and how long delivery takes.
Vitality puffer: the store gives no fill or fabric details. Do not say 'down'. The vest photo suggests zip-off sleeves; confirm on the page before saying it.
AMO Betty: store says 'shearling'. It does not say real or faux. Do not claim either. Tagged final sale.
Marine Layer Hayes: tagged final sale / last call in the catalog. Say it only if the page says it.
alice + olivia: homepage says 25% off Black Friday sale; the 40% is the catalog markdown. Check if anything extra applies at checkout.
Marcella Maren: the 40% is the catalog price ($239 vs $399). Confirm no code is needed.
dropped: Blazers (28 at 40%+ in US-dollar stores): left out on purpose, they are their own video
M.M.LaFleur (18): every 'jacket' is a suit jacket or blazer, not outerwear
Organic Basics (21): all track jackets and zip-ups, several of them men's
Vitality (13 of 16): gym zip-ups; kept only the 3 puffers
P.E Nation (40), DISSH, With Consideration: priced in A$
Odd Muse (22), Beyond Nine (4): priced in £
Sisterly Tribe: activewear zip jacket, and prices (999, 699) do not look like USD
Sterling Forever: 'jacket earrings'. Knix, Softies: activewear and loungewear jackets
Marcella Rockland Denim Jacket: one product listed under 3 handles, counted once
Marcella Nomad and Samuelle: a hoodie and a sweatshirt jacket
MONROW Sherpa Soft Knit Jacket (2), vest, cardigan: fleece zip-ups, not coats
alice + olivia sheer organza trenches (2): counted because they are sold as trenches, but not picked. You can see through them
Marcella Crosstown Trench khaki: good, but M and XL are sold out and the list already had two trenches
Marine Layer Rowan Anorak: neon pink windbreaker, not picked
